tools.name: devpilot_accessibility_audit
tools.description: Server-side accessibility audit: WCAG contrast ratio, font_size minimums, focus chain on interactive controls. Markdown report.

tools.name: devpilot_apply_custom_blueprint
tools.description: Apply a custom blueprint defined as JSON in .devpilot/custom_blueprints/<name>.json. JSON shape: { name, description?, scripts?: [{path, content}], scenes?: [SceneSpec...] }. Auto-lints GDScript + records to manifest.

tools.name: devpilot_apply_game_design_plan
tools.description: Apply a supported 2D GameDesignPlan. Existing scene, node and script creation steps are skipped; other failures are reported.

tools.name: devpilot_apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a preset by category + name. input_map writes [input] section to project.godot. physics_layers writes [layer_names]. hud generates scenes/HUD.tscn + scripts/HUD.gd. Existing entries are replaced.

tools.name: devpilot_apply_refinement
tools.description: Apply a refinement plan: scans current manifest, detects added/removed entities & systems vs the new plan, and executes only the patches needed (calls add_autoload, applies missing blueprints, deletes obsolete files). Pair with devpilot_refine_plan.

tools.name: devpilot_audit_3d_scene
tools.description: Inspect a Godot .tscn for common 3D setup gaps: collision shapes, meshes, navigation, environment and playable-scene camera. Static read-only check; instanced or scripted resources need editor verification.

tools.name: devpilot_author_dialogue_graph
tools.description: Author a DialogueGraph .tres from JSON. Avoids manual Inspector authoring. Lines: [{id, speaker, text, choices?: [{label, next_id}], next_id?}]. Pair with dialogue_system blueprint.

tools.name: devpilot_auto_fix_parse_errors
tools.description: Heuristic auto-fix loop: scans project scripts for known parse errors, applies known fixes (gdscriptLint on affected scripts, * prefix on disabled autoloads in project.godot), and re-checks. Returns lists of fixed files + remaining errors.

tools.name: devpilot_auto_wire_signals
tools.description: Scan manifest signals_map + script files; suggest signal connections for emitter/listener pairs. Outputs GDScript snippet ready to paste into a manager (no automatic editor mutation).

tools.name: devpilot_balance_level_difficulty
tools.description: Compute heuristic difficulty score for a level (enemies + gaps + length) and suggest adjustments.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_achievements
tools.description: Local achievements manager (autoload-ready) + Achievement Resource. Persists unlocks at user://achievements.cfg. Override _on_unlock for Steam/GameJolt integration.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_animation_state_machine
tools.description: AnimationTree state machine helper. Sets up idle/walk/run/attack states + travel API. Attach this script to a node that already owns AnimationPlayer + AnimationTree (you author the actual AnimationLibraries in editor).

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_audio_bus
tools.description: Default 3-bus layout (Master/Music/SFX) + AudioManager autoload (play_music/stop_music/play_sfx pool/set_bus_volume). Writes default_bus_layout.tres at project root and sets up SFX pool of 8 players.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_behavior_tree
tools.description: Behavior tree library: BTNode base + BTSequence + BTSelector + BTMoveTo example leaf + BTRunner Node. Wire by composing BTNode resources + assigning to a BTRunner.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_boss_arena
tools.description: Apply boss arena blueprint: BossBase.gd w/ 3 attack patterns (radial 8, 3-shot burst, 5-shot sweep) + Boss.tscn placeholder. Override _emit_bullet() in subclass.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_chest
tools.description: Apply chest blueprint: Area2D with interact-to-open + opened signal + Prompt label.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_csharp_player
tools.description: [C#] Skeleton C# player CharacterBody2D class. Use as template for C# projects. Drop into existing Godot.NET project — DevPilot does not compile C#.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_dialogue_system
tools.description: [RPG] Resource-based dialogue: DialogueLine + DialogueGraph + DialogueManager autoload + DialogueBox UI scene. Supports speaker/text/choices/branching.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_dungeon_room
tools.description: Apply dungeon room blueprint: Room.tscn (perimeter walls + 4 fills + 4 doors + 6 spawn points + EnterTrigger) + Door.tscn + RoomManager.gd + DungeonManager.gd + Door.gd. Register DungeonManager as autoload manually.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_dungeon_room_3d
tools.description: [3D] Room3D 16x16 floor + 4 walls + DirectionalLight. StaticBody3D walls with BoxShape3D collision. No script attached — purely level geometry.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_enemy_3d
tools.description: [3D] CharacterBody3D enemy with chase/contact AI + take_damage. BoxMesh placeholder red.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_gdextension_scaffold
tools.description: Generate a GDExtension C++ scaffold: .gdextension config + src/*.cpp/.h + SConstruct + README. DevPilot does not compile — user runs scons after cloning godot-cpp.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_inventory_drag_drop
tools.description: Drag-drop UI for inventory: InventoryDragSlot Control + InventoryDragPanel CanvasLayer. Bind to existing inventory_grid blueprint via /root/InventoryGrid autoload.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_inventory_grid
tools.description: [RPG] ItemData Resource + InventoryGrid autoload (slots, stack/merge, add/remove) + InventoryUI scene (toggleable grid panel).

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_localization
tools.description: Localization scaffold: translations.csv (en/pt seed) + LocaleManager autoload (set_locale/current_locale/t). Add translations.csv to Project Settings → Localization → Translations.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_loot_table
tools.description: [RPG] LootTable Resource (weighted entries) + LootRoller helper Node. roll() / roll_many(table, count).

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_navigation
tools.description: Navigation integration: NavAgentController helper that drives a CharacterBody2D parent through NavigationAgent2D pathfinding. Attach to enemy bodies. set_target(pos) updates goal.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_physics_puzzle
tools.description: Physics puzzle blueprint: DraggableBody (RigidBody2D + mouse drag) + PhysicsPuzzleHelper (build pin-jointed chain). Foundation for joint-based puzzle games.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_pickup
tools.description: Apply pickup blueprint: Area2D supporting kind=coin/heart/ammo with picked_up(kind, by) signal.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_player_3d
tools.description: [3D] CharacterBody3D player + camera (FPS or TPS) + mouse capture + WASD movement + jump + gravity. Mode param chooses fps/tps. Includes BoxMesh placeholder visual.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_procedural_dungeon
tools.description: BSP-based procedural dungeon generator autoload-ready. Emits dungeon_built(layout) signal with rooms + corridors. Configurable seed/grid/min/max room sizes. Pair with devpilot_blueprint_dungeon_room (2D) or _3d.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_projectile_3d
tools.description: [3D] Area3D projectile with BoxMesh + emissive material + lifetime + body collision.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_projectile_system
tools.description: Apply projectile system blueprint: Bullet.gd base + PlayerBullet.gd + EnemyBullet.gd + 2 scenes. Collision groups: player_bullets (layer 8), enemy_bullets (layer 16). Subclasses override _on_hit.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_quest_system
tools.description: [RPG] QuestData Resource + QuestManager autoload (register, start, complete_objective). Emits quest_started, quest_completed, objective_changed.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_rts_unit
tools.description: RTS unit blueprint: CharacterBody2D unit (selectable, move_to API) + RtsController (LMB select, RMB move, drag-rect group select). Ready for a strategy game prototype.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_save_migration
tools.description: Save migration helper: SaveMigration.migrate(dict) walks schema_version forward applying registered migrations. Edit _migrations() to add new versions.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_save_schema
tools.description: Resource-based save system: SaveData class + SaveManager autoload (save/load/delete .tres slots in user://). Type-safe, signals on completion/failure.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_scene_transitions
tools.description: SceneTransitions autoload: ColorRect overlay that fades to black between scenes. Methods: fade_to_scene(path, duration), flash(color, duration). Register as autoload manually.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_settings_manager
tools.description: SettingsManager autoload: persists user://settings.cfg. Helpers set_bus_volume, set_fullscreen, set_vsync, set_value/get_value. Auto-applies audio + video on _ready.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_shader_library
tools.description: 5 canvas_item shaders: outline, hit_flash, pixelate, dissolve, water. Apply via ShaderMaterial on Sprite2D. Each .gdshader file in shaders/.

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_shop_item
tools.description: Apply shop item blueprint: Area2D with item_kind + cost + interact-to-buy. Emits purchased(kind).

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_twin_stick
tools.description: Apply twin-stick player blueprint: PlayerTwinStick.gd + PlayerWeapon.gd + PlayerTwinStick.tscn. Reads input actions move_*, shoot_* (IJKL), shoot_mouse, dodge_roll, reload. Pair with devpilot_blueprint_projectile_system + devpilot_apply_preset (input_map: twin_stick).

tools.name: devpilot_blueprint_vfx_library
tools.description: VFX library: 5 GPUParticles2D scenes (explosion, fire, blood, sparkle, dust) + VFXBurst helper script (auto-emit + queue_free). Each is one_shot/explosiveness preset.

tools.name: devpilot_build_feature
tools.description: High-level workflow: plan → dry-run → create scene/script/nodes → backup → execute → validate → generate test → report. Orchestrates multiple MCP tools to build a complete Godot feature.

tools.name: devpilot_check_blueprint_dependencies
tools.description: Inspect manifest blueprints against the dependency registry. Reports missing requires (e.g. boss_arena requires enemy_bullet from projectile_system). Pure read — no mutations.

tools.name: devpilot_check_versions
tools.description: Compare blueprint template versions in manifest vs current MCP version. Lists blueprints applied with older template versions (candidates for migration).

tools.name: devpilot_compose_main_scene
tools.description: Auto-compose Main.tscn from blueprints recorded in manifest. Instances Player, Rooms, HUD, PauseMenu at sensible positions. Optionally sets project run/main_scene. Idempotent — pass overwrite=true to replace.

tools.name: devpilot_create_3d_starter
tools.description: Create a runnable FPS/TPS 3D starter scene with player controller, floor, walls, assigned meshes/colliders, camera, light and environment. Preserves an existing main scene and never overwrites edited files.

tools.name: devpilot_create_audio_settings
tools.description: Create Audio settings menu with Master/Music/SFX volume sliders bound to AudioServer buses.

tools.name: devpilot_create_damage_system
tools.description: Create DamageDealer (Area2D) and/or DamageReceiver (Node) scripts. Dealer triggers on body/area enter; receiver forwards to a health node via NodePath.

tools.name: devpilot_create_dialogue_database
tools.description: Create Dialogue Resource (with from_json static helper) + sample .json dialogue files.

tools.name: devpilot_create_enemy_database
tools.description: Create EnemyData Resource subclass + sample enemies + EnemyDB autoload helper.

tools.name: devpilot_create_game_over_screen
tools.description: Create a Game Over CanvasLayer with Retry / Main Menu buttons. Process mode = ALWAYS so it works while paused.

tools.name: devpilot_create_gameplay_loop
tools.description: Create a complete gameplay loop: player + enemy + collectible + health system + camera + save the scene. Orchestrates 2D toolkit tools.

tools.name: devpilot_create_health_system
tools.description: Create a Health system Node with health_changed/damaged/died signals + invincibility frames. Optionally attaches as child of an existing node.

tools.name: devpilot_create_hud
tools.description: Create a HUD CanvasLayer with HP label + ProgressBar wired to a player health node via NodePath.

tools.name: devpilot_create_interaction_system
tools.description: Create an Area2D interaction trigger that detects bodies in 'interactable' group and emits interact_pressed on input action.

tools.name: devpilot_create_inventory_system
tools.description: Create an inventory: InventoryItem Resource subclass (.gd with class_name) + Inventory Node script with add_item/remove_item/has_item.

tools.name: devpilot_create_item_database
tools.description: Create Item Resource subclass + sample .tres entries + ItemDB autoload helper for id-based lookup. Default 5 sample items.

tools.name: devpilot_create_keybinding_menu
tools.description: Create a Keybinding rebind menu. Auto-iterates non-ui_* InputMap actions and provides press-to-rebind buttons.

tools.name: devpilot_create_level_select_screen
tools.description: Create a Level Select grid that auto-discovers .tscn files from a folder (default res://scenes/levels/).

tools.name: devpilot_create_loot_table
tools.description: Create LootTable Resource subclass with weighted roll() method. Stored as a single resource at script_path.

tools.name: devpilot_create_main_menu
tools.description: Create a Main Menu CanvasLayer with Play/Settings/Quit buttons. First button auto-grabs focus.

tools.name: devpilot_create_pause_menu
tools.description: Create a PauseMenu CanvasLayer with dim background + Resume/Quit buttons. Toggles visibility on pause_action (default ui_cancel) and pauses the tree.

tools.name: devpilot_create_platformer_blueprint
tools.description: Platformer scaffold: scene, movement script, empty TileMapLayer, enemies, collectibles, camera and HUD. Add a TileSet and collision before playtesting.

tools.name: devpilot_create_playable_prototype
tools.description: Generate a 2D prototype scaffold from a supported GameDesignPlan: creates scene, player, enemies and collectibles. Custom genres and 3D plans require composition with other Godot tools. Optionally runs the project for 3s; gameplay still needs a playtest.

tools.name: devpilot_create_player_controller_2d
tools.description: Create a complete 2D player: CharacterBody2D + Sprite2D + CollisionShape2D + Camera2D + script. Style: platformer | topdown | sidescroller. Requires open scene.

tools.name: devpilot_create_project_archetype
tools.description: Return the canonical playbook (sequence of MCP tool calls) for an archetype. Pure planning — no side effects. The LLM client then iterates the steps and calls each tool. Use devpilot_list_archetypes first.

tools.name: devpilot_create_puzzle_blueprint
tools.description: Tile-swap puzzle template: grid + swap mechanic + score HUD.

tools.name: devpilot_create_quest_database
tools.description: Create Quest Resource subclass + sample .tres quests + QuestDB autoload.

tools.name: devpilot_create_save_system
tools.description: Create a SaveSystem singleton (autoload) with save_game/load_game using JSON in user://savegame.json. Auto-registers as autoload.

tools.name: devpilot_create_settings_menu
tools.description: Create a Settings hub menu with Back button. Tabs (audio/video/keybinding) created via separate tools.

tools.name: devpilot_create_spawn_table
tools.description: Create SpawnTable Resource subclass with pick(active_counts) method enforcing per-enemy max_simultaneous.

tools.name: devpilot_create_survivor_like_blueprint
tools.description: Survivor-like (bullet-heaven) template: player + auto-shooter weapon + spawn manager (waves) + XP system. Enemy/collectible/HUD wired via groups.

tools.name: devpilot_create_top_down_rpg_blueprint
tools.description: Full top-down RPG template: player (8-dir) + N NPCs in 'interactable' group + dialogue box + inventory + save system + HUD.

tools.name: devpilot_create_tower_defense_blueprint
tools.description: Tower defense template: Path2D + tower placement + enemy waves + currency. Tower/enemy scenes assigned later.

tools.name: devpilot_create_video_settings
tools.description: Create Video settings menu (resolution OptionButton, fullscreen + vsync CheckBoxes).

tools.name: devpilot_create_visual_novel_blueprint
tools.description: Visual novel template: background + character sprite + dialogue box + branching dialogue Resource. Reads dialogue.json from res://data/.

tools.name: devpilot_define_scene
tools.description: Serialize a JSON SceneSpec into a Godot 4 .tscn file. Faster than dozens of node.add RPCs. Use {__sub:'id'} for SubResource refs (e.g. shapes), {__ext:'id'} for ExtResource refs. Vectors as {x,y}, colors as {r,g,b,a}. Polygon arrays via {__packed_vector2:[x1,y1,...]}. Returns absolute + res:// path.

tools.name: devpilot_define_tilemap
tools.description: Generate a TileMapLayer scene + helper script with `populate(cells)` and `clear_all()` methods. cells param accepts [[x,y,source_id,atlas_x,atlas_y]...]. TileSet starts empty (16×16) — attach an atlas in editor or via sub_resource patching.

tools.name: devpilot_describe_blueprint
tools.description: Describe a specific blueprint: full description, files it creates, parameter schema, example invocation. Use after devpilot_list_blueprints to plan which blueprints to apply.

tools.name: devpilot_design_game_from_prompt
tools.description: Draft a structured plan for any game concept. Unknown genres remain custom, and 3D is identified explicitly. The automatic prototype generator supports only its listed 2D patterns; use engine tools for other plans. Persists to .godot_mcp/memory/game_design.{md,json}.

tools.name: devpilot_detect_language_support
tools.description: Detect whether the project uses GDScript only, C#, both. DevPilot blueprints generate GDScript; on C# projects, blueprints still place .gd files but the code base may not use them directly — flagged here.

tools.name: devpilot_diff_snapshot
tools.description: Diff a snapshot vs current project state. Reports added/removed/modified files within scenes/, scripts/, project.godot.

tools.name: devpilot_execute_prompt_workflow
tools.description: Prompt-first orchestrator. Routes the prompt, builds a plan, executes via existing internal helpers and Godot RPC, validates and writes a report. Set dry_run=true for preview-only (no mutation).

tools.name: devpilot_explain_project
tools.description: Generate a Markdown summary of the current project: autoloads, main scene, blueprints applied, signals graph (from manifest), input actions, file counts. Useful as context for the LLM in subsequent turns.

tools.name: devpilot_find_tools
tools.description: Find the active GodoPilot tools for a task. Search in Portuguese or English; returns concise parameters and version/addon requirements.

tools.name: devpilot_fix_bug
tools.description: Automated bug fix workflow: get errors → analyze → fix → validate → run → report. Calls godot_fix_errors with dry_run first, then applies if safe.

tools.name: devpilot_game
tools.description: One-shot prompt-first game builder. Takes a natural-language prompt and runs the full DevPilot pipeline: route → plan → execute → validate → report. Wraps devpilot_execute_prompt_workflow with simplified UX (single tool, sane defaults, suggested follow-up prompts). Use this as the primary entry point.

tools.name: devpilot_game_context
tools.description: Get a bounded game-focused context: main scene, scene/script/asset paths, addons and missing references. Excludes addon files from game counts.

tools.name: devpilot_generate_dungeon_layout
tools.description: BSP-partitioned dungeon: rooms + corridors connecting them. Renders to TileMap. Returns rooms metadata.

tools.name: devpilot_generate_platformer_level
tools.description: Procedural platformer level: alternating floor + gap + raised platform. Returns a list of cells written to the TileMap.

tools.name: devpilot_generate_prompt_plan
tools.description: Build a structured WorkflowPlan (steps, validation, next prompts) for a given prompt + mode. Pure function — no side effects.

tools.name: devpilot_generate_tests
tools.description: Scaffold GUT-style test files for blueprints recorded in the manifest. Writes minimal `extends GutTest` skeletons to res://tests/.

tools.name: devpilot_generate_tests_v2
tools.description: Generate GUT test files with real assertions (per blueprint kind), not just empty scaffolds. Inspects manifest scripts and emits assertion templates targeted at each script's role.

tools.name: devpilot_generate_tilemap_level
tools.description: Fill a TileMap programmatically with a pattern (solid/noise/borders). Calls tilemap.set_cell or fill_rect repeatedly.

tools.name: devpilot_generate_workflow_report
tools.description: Render the last workflow execution as Markdown. Reads .devpilot/reports/latest.json. Optionally rewrites latest.md.

tools.name: devpilot_help
tools.description: Show DevPilot quickstart, tool tier list (core/blueprints/iteration/quality/legacy), and conventions. First call when starting a session — gives an overview of available capabilities and recommended workflow.

tools.name: devpilot_init_wizard
tools.description: Run a first-run health check: verifies project.godot, addon install/enable, input map, autoloads, scenes/scripts dirs, read-only flag, and bridge reachability. Returns a checklist with severities and actionable fixes. Pass apply_fixes=true to auto-create missing folders (non-mutating in read-only).

tools.name: devpilot_list_archetypes
tools.description: List canonical project archetypes (curated combos of presets+blueprints+autoloads). Use to fast-start a project: shooter_2d, dungeon_crawler, rpg_topdown, platformer, fps_3d, rts_2d, physics_puzzle.

tools.name: devpilot_list_blueprints
tools.description: List all DevPilot blueprints with their categories + summaries. Use to discover composable building blocks before planning a project. Pair with devpilot_describe_blueprint(name) for details.

tools.name: devpilot_list_custom_blueprints
tools.description: List user-defined blueprints in .devpilot/custom_blueprints/*.json. Each JSON file declares scripts + scenes that can be applied via devpilot_apply_custom_blueprint.

tools.name: devpilot_list_presets
tools.description: List available presets per category. Categories: input_map (twin_stick, platformer, topdown), physics_layers (shooter, platformer, topdown_rpg), hud (shooter, rpg, survivor).

tools.name: devpilot_list_snapshots
tools.description: List existing snapshots in .devpilot/snapshots/ with creation time + label.

tools.name: devpilot_list_tools_by_tier
tools.description: List MCP tool names categorized as 'core' (recommended starting set) vs 'advanced' (specialized). Use to scope which tools to learn first.

tools.name: devpilot_manifest_get
tools.description: Read .godot_mcp/manifest.json. Source-of-truth for files DevPilot generated, scene/script registry, autoloads, and applied blueprints. Returns empty manifest if not present.

tools.name: devpilot_manifest_update
tools.description: Merge a partial manifest patch into .godot_mcp/manifest.json. Arrays are de-duplicated; objects are shallow-merged. Use sparingly — most updates happen automatically when codegen tools record their output.

tools.name: devpilot_performance_audit
tools.description: Run the project for N seconds, sample FPS + process stats, write markdown report. Flags FPS<60, draw_calls>1000, nodes>5000.

tools.name: devpilot_performance_budget
tools.description: Static performance scan over scenes/. Counts node types, flags large scenes, suggests pooling thresholds. Read-only — no mutations.

tools.name: devpilot_place_spawns_and_collectibles
tools.description: Read tilemap.get_used_cells, identify floor tiles (cells with empty cell directly above), randomly distribute scene instances at those positions.

tools.name: devpilot_prepare_export_release
tools.description: Full release preparation workflow: validate project → check export presets → generate release checklist → run validation loop → produce export commands. Returns ready-to-ship status.

tools.name: devpilot_prune_snapshots
tools.description: Delete older snapshots, keeping the most recent N. Snapshots accumulate disk usage; prune periodically.

tools.name: devpilot_recommend_blueprints
tools.description: Given a free-text prompt, return a recommended sequence of blueprints + presets to apply. Pure planning — no side-effects. LLM should review then call individual blueprint/preset tools.

tools.name: devpilot_refactor_scene_safely
tools.description: Safe scene refactor workflow: impact check → dry-run → backup → apply changes → validate → report.

tools.name: devpilot_refine_plan
tools.description: Refine an existing GameDesignPlan with a delta prompt (e.g., 'add inventory and save', '5 enemies instead of 3', 'rename to Foo', 'remove npc'). If no plan passed, loads from .godot_mcp/memory/game_design.json. Persists the new plan unless persist=false.

tools.name: devpilot_register_custom_blueprint
tools.description: Save a custom blueprint JSON to .devpilot/custom_blueprints/<name>.json. Useful for teams to share project-specific scaffolding.

tools.name: devpilot_reload_editor
tools.description: Best-effort: send RPC to addon asking editor to rescan filesystem. Limited — Godot does not expose project.godot reload. After running, you may still need Project → Reload Current Project for autoload/input changes.

tools.name: devpilot_review_gdscript
tools.description: Review one project GDScript for Godot naming, readability, optional typing and scene coupling. Read only and advisory; use Godot validation for syntax.

tools.name: devpilot_rollback_to_snapshot
tools.description: Restore project from a snapshot. Replaces current scenes/, scripts/, project.godot, manifest with the snapshot's copies. Destructive — pass confirm=true.

tools.name: devpilot_route_prompt
tools.description: Classify a natural-language game-dev prompt into a DevPilot workflow mode (CREATE, CONTINUE, ADD_FEATURE, FIX_BUG, POLISH, VALIDATE). Returns intent, confidence, risk level, and recommended workflow.

tools.name: devpilot_run_gut_tests
tools.description: Run an installed GUT test directory or .gd test script headlessly and return the exit status and output. Requires addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd in the game project.

tools.name: devpilot_run_headless
tools.description: Run the project headless via Godot CLI for N wall-clock seconds, capture stdout+stderr and report runtime errors.

tools.name: devpilot_setup_asset_pack
tools.description: Create assets/ folder convention (kenney/opengameart/custom/generated/sfx/music) and write a README pointing to free CC0 sources. No bundling — user downloads packs manually.

tools.name: devpilot_setup_ci
tools.description: Generate a CI workflow file for the project. Targets: github_actions (.github/workflows/godot-build.yml), gitlab (.gitlab-ci.yml), circleci (.circleci/config.yml). Configures multi-platform export + test stub.

tools.name: devpilot_setup_csharp_project
tools.description: Generate a basic .csproj at project root (Godot.NET.Sdk 4.3). Does not migrate existing GDScript — coexists.

tools.name: devpilot_setup_export_preset
tools.description: Append an export preset entry to export_presets.cfg for the chosen target. Existing presets are kept. Targets: windows, linux, mac, web, android, ios. After running, open Project → Export in Godot to finalize templates/icons.

tools.name: devpilot_signal_graph
tools.description: Return signals graph from manifest as Markdown + JSON. Each signal lists the scripts that emit it.

tools.name: devpilot_snapshot_project
tools.description: Snapshot the current project (scenes/, scripts/, project.godot, manifest) into .devpilot/snapshots/<id>/. Use before risky refactors.

tools.name: devpilot_stream_runtime_metrics
tools.description: Sample runtime.get_process_stats over N seconds to capture FPS, memory and draw calls timeline. Useful while game is running to spot performance dips.

tools.name: devpilot_telemetry
tools.description: Opt-in usage telemetry. Local-only by default — writes counts to .devpilot/telemetry.json. Useful to see which tools you actually use. Pass enable:true/false to toggle, action:'view' to read counts.

tools.name: devpilot_tune_camera_feel
tools.description: Tune Camera2D feel via property mutations. Presets: cinematic (smooth + drag), twitchy (instant), anchored (locked).

tools.name: devpilot_tune_combat_balance
tools.description: Heuristic combat balance: takes player HP + average enemy HP/damage and target time-to-kill, suggests adjustments. Returns markdown report.

tools.name: devpilot_tune_jump_arc
tools.description: Compute platformer physics constants from human-meaningful inputs (jump height in pixels + time to apex). Returns gravity + jump_velocity. Optionally patches the player script.

tools.name: devpilot_tune_player_movement
tools.description: Tune a player script's movement constants. Patches the script's @export speed/friction/acceleration values via script.patch (permanent) or runtime.set_property (temporary). Presets: floaty/snappy/heavy/responsive.

tools.name: devpilot_tutorial
tools.description: Step-by-step interactive tutorial. Pass step:1..7 to get focused guidance for that phase. Combined with devpilot_help for overview-level info.

tools.name: devpilot_validate_blueprint_compat
tools.description: Check whether applying a blueprint conflicts with the manifest state. Returns conflicts (file collisions, duplicate categories).

tools.name: devpilot_validate_level_playability
tools.description: A* pathfinding check from start to end over walkable cells (cells NOT in tilemap.get_used_cells). Returns reachability + path length + dead-end count.

tools.name: devpilot_validate_menu
tools.description: Validate a menu UI: checks focus chain (focus_neighbor_*), pressed signal connections, anchors, theme assignment, and back-navigation. Reports issues by category.

tools.name: devpilot_validate_project
tools.description: Complete project validation: project doctor + open all scenes + check conventions + run game + report. One-command full health check.

tools.name: devpilot_verify_spec
tools.description: Run a checklist of acceptance criteria against the current project state. Each criterion is a typed check (file_exists, file_count, autoload_exists, input_action_exists, main_scene_is, blueprint_applied, script_extends, script_has_signal, project_setting). Returns pass/fail per criterion.

tools.name: devpilot_workspace_list
tools.description: List registered workspaces from ~/.devpilot/workspaces.json.

tools.name: devpilot_workspace_register
tools.description: Register the current project (or a custom path) as a workspace at ~/.devpilot/workspaces.json. Lets future MCP sessions list projects.

tools.name: godot_add_animation_track
tools.description: Create a real AnimationLibrary, Animation and typed property track with keyframes on an AnimationPlayer in the open scene. Supports UndoRedo.

tools.name: godot_add_audio_bus
tools.description: Add a new audio bus to the AudioServer.

tools.name: godot_add_audio_bus_effect
tools.description: Add an effect to an audio bus (reverb, delay, compressor, equalizer, limiter).

tools.name: godot_add_autoload
tools.description: Registers a new autoload singleton in the project. Persists to project.godot. Requires read-only mode to be disabled.

tools.name: godot_add_input_action
tools.description: Adds a new Input Map action to the project. Persists to project.godot. Requires read-only mode to be disabled.

tools.name: godot_add_node
tools.description: Add a child node to an existing node in the current scene.

tools.name: godot_add_node_to_group
tools.description: Add a node to a group in the current scene.

tools.name: godot_add_raycast_2d
tools.description: Add a RayCast2D node with target_position and enabled=true.

tools.name: godot_add_scene_instance
tools.description: Instantiate a PackedScene (.tscn) as a child of a node in the current scene.

tools.name: godot_add_state_machine_state
tools.description: Add a state to an AnimationStateMachine inside an AnimationTree.

tools.name: godot_add_state_machine_transition
tools.description: Add a transition between two states in an AnimationStateMachine.

tools.name: godot_analyze_architecture
tools.description: Architectural overview: counts, top-level dirs, dependency hubs, signal density.

tools.name: godot_analyze_scene_architecture
tools.description: Review the current scene tree, attached scripts, connections, dependencies, node names and deep nesting. Findings are advisory; repeated node types and scriptless nodes are normal.

tools.name: godot_assert_no_errors
tools.description: Assert that the last run report contains no error events. Returns ok=false if errors are found.

tools.name: godot_assert_node_exists
tools.description: Assert that a node exists at the given path in the running scene.

tools.name: godot_assert_property_equals
tools.description: Assert that a node property equals an expected value (deep equality via JSON.stringify).

tools.name: godot_assert_screenshot_matches
tools.description: Assert that two screenshots are byte-identical or below a byte_diff threshold.

tools.name: godot_assert_screenshot_matches_pixel
tools.description: Pixel-aware assertion. Pass if similarity_pct ≥ min_similarity. Fails with diff stats and optional diff image.

tools.name: godot_assert_signal_emitted
tools.description: Assert that a signal connection exists in any cached signal map for the given source/signal pair.

tools.name: godot_assign_resource
tools.description: Assign a compatible built-in Resource class or existing .tres/.res file to a typed node property, with UndoRedo.

tools.name: godot_assign_shader_material
tools.description: Document how to assign a shader material to a CanvasItem/MeshInstance node (Resource instancing limitation).

tools.name: godot_attach_script
tools.description: Attach a GDScript file to a node using Godot editor UndoRedo.

tools.name: godot_audit_gltf
tools.description: Inspect a glTF/GLB scene already imported by Godot. Reports meshes, material coverage, animations, skeletons, collision and non-unit scales; visual orientation still requires review.

tools.name: godot_audit_scene
tools.description: Audit a scene for structural issues, invalid ownership, missing scripts and common scene hygiene problems.

tools.name: godot_bake_navigation_mesh_3d
tools.description: Bake a NavigationRegion3D from meshes and static colliders in the open scene. Replaces its navigation mesh with an undoable resource only when walkable polygons are produced.

tools.name: godot_batch_set_property
tools.description: Set the same property to the same value on multiple nodes at once (UndoRedo-backed).

tools.name: godot_begin_transaction
tools.description: Start a transaction by snapshotting a list of files. Returns tx_id. Use commit/rollback to finalize. Files in the project are copied to .godot_mcp/tx/<tx_id>/.

tools.name: godot_better_tile_editor_assign_tile
tools.description: Associate an existing atlas tile with a Better Tile Editor terrain.

tools.name: godot_better_tile_editor_create_terrain
tools.description: Add a Better Tile Editor terrain to the TileSet on an open TileMapLayer. Assign atlas tiles before painting.

tools.name: godot_better_tile_editor_list_terrains
tools.description: List Better Tile Editor terrain IDs configured in the TileSet of an open TileMapLayer.

tools.name: godot_better_tile_editor_paint_terrain
tools.description: Paint terrain cells using Better Tile Editor and update neighboring terrain tiles. The scene is saved after painting.

tools.name: godot_better_tile_editor_status
tools.description: Check whether the optional Better Tile Editor addon is installed and enabled in this Godot project.

tools.name: godot_bind_joypad_button
tools.description: Bind a joypad/gamepad button to an existing InputMap action.

tools.name: godot_bind_key
tools.description: Bind a keyboard key to an existing InputMap action.

tools.name: godot_build_dependency_graph
tools.description: Build dependency graph (preload/load/extends/scene_resource) and cache it to .godot_mcp/intel/dependency_graph.json.

tools.name: godot_build_feature
tools.description: Generate a multi-step plan for a feature (scene + script + nodes + memory note). dry_run=true by default returns the plan; dry_run=false executes it.

tools.name: godot_build_signal_map
tools.description: Scan all .tscn files for signal connections and cache them to .godot_mcp/intel/signal_map.json.

tools.name: godot_clear_logs
tools.description: Delete all run report files from .godot_mcp/logs/run_reports/.

tools.name: godot_click_ui_by_text
tools.description: Find a Control by visible text and simulate a click at its center.

tools.name: godot_commit_transaction
tools.description: Mark a transaction as committed. Optionally cleanup snapshot files.

tools.name: godot_compare_screenshots
tools.description: Compare two screenshot PNG files using SHA256 hash, file size, dimensions, and byte-level diff count.

tools.name: godot_compare_screenshots_pixel
tools.description: Pixel-aware PNG screenshot diff. Returns similarity_pct, diff_pixels, and optionally writes diff_image highlighting differences. Closes ISSUE-009.

tools.name: godot_connect_signal
tools.description: Connect a signal from a source node to a method on a target node.

tools.name: godot_create_animation_player
tools.description: Add an AnimationPlayer node under a parent.

tools.name: godot_create_animation_tree
tools.description: Add an AnimationTree node configured to use an AnimationPlayer (anim_player property).

tools.name: godot_create_audio_stream_player_2d
tools.description: Add an AudioStreamPlayer2D under a parent and configure bus/volume.

tools.name: godot_create_audio_stream_player_3d
tools.description: Add an AudioStreamPlayer3D for spatial audio.

tools.name: godot_create_character_body_3d
tools.description: Create a CharacterBody3D node tree (body + MeshInstance3D + CollisionShape3D + CameraPivot/Camera3D) with the third-person controller script.

tools.name: godot_create_collectible_2d
tools.description: Create a 2D Collectible node tree (Area2D + Sprite2D + CollisionShape2D) with a collect script.

tools.name: godot_create_decision_record
tools.description: Create an Architecture Decision Record (ADR-style) in .godot_mcp/memory/decisions/.

tools.name: godot_create_enemy_2d
tools.description: Create a 2D Enemy node tree (CharacterBody2D + Sprite2D + CollisionShape2D) with a patrol script.

tools.name: godot_create_game_jam_prototype
tools.description: Create a scene scaffold with optional HUD, light and environment. Player, camera and playtest are separate steps. dry_run=true unless explicitly opted out.

tools.name: godot_create_gameplay_system
tools.description: Compose a baseline gameplay system using existing toolkits.

tools.name: godot_create_gpu_particles_2d
tools.description: Add a GPUParticles2D node configured with amount and emitting flag.

tools.name: godot_create_gpu_particles_3d
tools.description: Add a GPUParticles3D node configured with amount and emitting flag.

tools.name: godot_create_gridmap_3d
tools.description: Create a GridMap for modular 3D level building. Use a project MeshLibrary, or omit it for a basic collidable Block palette.

tools.name: godot_create_health_system
tools.description: Create a HealthSystem GDScript with health_changed and died signals. Optionally attach to a node.

tools.name: godot_create_inventory_ui
tools.description: Create a baseline inventory UI (CanvasLayer + Control + GridContainer) with an InventoryUI script.

tools.name: godot_create_navigation_region_3d
tools.description: Add a NavigationRegion3D with a flat rectangular NavigationMesh. For obstacles or complex levels, bake a new mesh in the Godot editor.

tools.name: godot_create_platformer_controller
tools.description: Generate a platformer movement GDScript template. Does not create any nodes.

tools.name: godot_create_playable_prototype
tools.description: Create a scene scaffold and suggest player/camera tools. It is not playable until those steps are applied and tested. dry_run=true by default.

tools.name: godot_create_player_2d
tools.description: Create a 2D Player node tree (CharacterBody2D + Sprite2D + CollisionShape2D) with a movement script. Requires an open scene.

tools.name: godot_create_primitive_mesh
tools.description: Add a MeshInstance3D with an assigned primitive Mesh resource under a parent.

tools.name: godot_create_raycast_3d
tools.description: Add a RayCast3D node and configure its target_position.

tools.name: godot_create_resource
tools.description: Create a typed .tres resource. Existing resources require overwrite=true and receive a recoverable backup.

tools.name: godot_create_scene
tools.description: Create a new .tscn file with a root node of the given type.

tools.name: godot_create_script
tools.description: Create a GDScript file inside the Godot project.

tools.name: godot_create_shader
tools.description: Generate a baseline .gdshader file (canvas_item or spatial) inside the project.

tools.name: godot_create_test_scenario
tools.description: Persist a test scenario JSON file inside .godot_mcp/tests/<name>.json for later reuse with godot_run_test_scenario.

tools.name: godot_create_theme
tools.description: Create a new Theme resource .tres file.

tools.name: godot_create_tile_atlas
tools.description: Create a Godot TileSet atlas from an existing project texture. This works without Better Tile Editor; terrain metadata can be added afterwards.

tools.name: godot_create_tilemap
tools.description: Add a TileMap node under a parent. TileSet resource must be assigned in editor.

tools.name: godot_create_topdown_controller
tools.description: Generate a top-down movement GDScript template. Does not create any nodes.

tools.name: godot_cross_scene_set_property
tools.description: Set a property on a node in every .tscn file in the project that matches a class filter.

tools.name: godot_detect_circular_dependencies
tools.description: Detect circular script dependencies (A extends B extends A) in the project.

tools.name: godot_detect_conventions
tools.description: Scan all .gd and .tscn files and infer project conventions (naming, indent, depth, script coverage). Returns inferred rules + sample evidence.

tools.name: godot_detect_gameplay_systems
tools.description: Heuristically detect gameplay systems by scanning script and scene names for common patterns.

tools.name: godot_detect_missing_singletons
tools.description: Find all autoload singletons referenced in scripts that are not registered in the project's autoload list.

tools.name: godot_diff_file
tools.description: Compare a file's current content with proposed content. Returns added/removed/unchanged line counts and unified diff. No mutation.

tools.name: godot_diff_scene
tools.description: Compare a .tscn file's current scene tree with a proposed .tscn content. Returns node-level adds/removes/changes.

tools.name: godot_disconnect_signal
tools.description: Disconnect a signal connection between two nodes.

tools.name: godot_duplicate_node
tools.description: Duplicate a node and add the copy as a sibling.

tools.name: godot_duplicate_scene
tools.description: Duplicate a .tscn file to a new path.

tools.name: godot_edit_resource
tools.description: Modify a typed stored property on an existing .tres or .res resource and save it after creating a recoverable backup.

tools.name: godot_enforce_conventions
tools.description: Check current project against rules (provided or auto-detected) and report violations. dry_run reports only; with dry_run=false, writes a markdown report to .godot_mcp/reports/conventions_violations.md.

tools.name: godot_execute_editor_script
tools.description: Advanced: execute arbitrary GDScript in the editor context. Returns output captured by _print(). The editor cannot interrupt a running script; prefer typed tools for routine changes.

tools.name: godot_execute_game_script
tools.description: Advanced: execute arbitrary GDScript against the running game scene. Requires project to be running; the editor cannot interrupt a running script.

tools.name: godot_explain_project_architecture
tools.description: Compose project summary + dependency hubs + signal density + memory architecture notes into a single LLM-friendly markdown report.

tools.name: godot_export_eval_report
tools.description: Read existing evals/results/*.result.json files and generate a fresh markdown report (no re-execution).

tools.name: godot_export_project
tools.description: Export a real build with a configured Godot preset and verify the output. Works without an open editor; requires installed export templates and writes under res://builds/.

tools.name: godot_find_nodes_by_type
tools.description: Find all nodes of a given class type in the current scene (or recursively in all open scenes).

tools.name: godot_find_references
tools.description: Find text references in GDScript files.

tools.name: godot_find_runtime_node
tools.description: Find nodes in the running scene by name, type, or group.

tools.name: godot_find_ui_element
tools.description: Find a Control node by visible text or name in the running scene.

tools.name: godot_find_unused_resources
tools.description: Scan the project for resource files (.tres/.res/.png/.wav etc.) not referenced by any scene or script.

tools.name: godot_fix_errors
tools.description: Generate or apply auto-fixes for static GDScript parse errors. Always run with dry_run=true first to review the plan.

tools.name: godot_fix_errors_agentic
tools.description: Agentic wrapper hint: delegates to godot_fix_errors (Phase 6). Returns guidance for safer multi-pass fix loops.

tools.name: godot_format_script
tools.description: Apply conservative GDScript formatting: LF endings, trim trailing whitespace and final newline.

tools.name: godot_generate_regression_test
tools.description: Snapshot the current running scene tree and generate a test scenario JSON that asserts the same structure on later runs.

tools.name: godot_generate_scene_from_prompt
tools.description: Generate a scene scaffold from keyword tags. Maps tags to node templates (player, enemy, hud, camera, light, collision).

tools.name: godot_generate_test_from_behavior
tools.description: Observe the running game for a duration, capture scene tree + node properties + FPS samples, then automatically generate a test scenario JSON that asserts the same runtime state on future runs. This is the agentic test generation tool — no manual test writing required.

tools.name: godot_get_animation_tree_structure
tools.description: Inspect the full structure of an AnimationTree node (states, transitions, parameters).

tools.name: godot_get_architecture_notes
tools.description: Return architecture notes from .godot_mcp/memory/architecture.md.

tools.name: godot_get_audio_bus_layout
tools.description: Get the full audio bus layout (all buses with volumes, effects, routing).

tools.name: godot_get_audio_info
tools.description: Audit all audio nodes in the current scene (AudioStreamPlayer2D/3D).

tools.name: godot_get_autoloads
tools.description: Returns all autoload singletons registered in the project. Requires Godot editor to be running with the plugin active.

tools.name: godot_get_capabilities
tools.description: Returns phase 1 server capabilities and reconciles plugin capabilities when the editor bridge is connected.

tools.name: godot_get_classdb_info
tools.description: Get ClassDB information for a Godot engine class, optionally with paginated typed methods, properties, signals and enums. Script-defined class_name types are not in ClassDB.

tools.name: godot_get_connection_status
tools.description: Returns local WebSocket connection diagnostics without requiring Godot to be connected.

tools.name: godot_get_conventions
tools.description: Return project conventions from .godot_mcp/memory/conventions.md.

tools.name: godot_get_current_camera
tools.description: Get the current Camera2D or Camera3D in the running scene.

tools.name: godot_get_current_task_context
tools.description: Return the current task context from current_task.md.

tools.name: godot_get_debugger_errors
tools.description: Get error events from recent run reports.

tools.name: godot_get_dependency_graph
tools.description: Return cached dependency graph. Builds it if cache is missing.

tools.name: godot_get_editor_context
tools.description: Returns the current scene, selected nodes and play state from the Godot editor. Requires Godot editor to be running with the plugin active.

tools.name: godot_get_export_info
tools.description: Get detailed export info for a specific preset (features, patches, templates).

tools.name: godot_get_fps
tools.description: Get current frames-per-second. Works in editor (returns editor FPS) and during runtime (returns game FPS).

tools.name: godot_get_gridmap_palette
tools.description: List item IDs, names, and collision/navigation coverage in a GridMap's MeshLibrary before placing cells.

tools.name: godot_get_input_map
tools.description: Returns all Input Map actions and their events. Requires Godot editor to be running with the plugin active.

tools.name: godot_get_last_run_report
tools.description: Get a summary of the most recent project run from .godot_mcp/logs/run_reports/.

tools.name: godot_get_node_groups
tools.description: List all groups a node belongs to.

tools.name: godot_get_node_properties
tools.description: List all editor-visible properties and their current values for a node.

tools.name: godot_get_open_scenes
tools.description: Returns the list of scenes currently open in the Godot editor. Requires Godot editor to be running with the plugin active.

tools.name: godot_get_output_logs
tools.description: Get output and error events from recent run reports stored in .godot_mcp/logs/run_reports/.

tools.name: godot_get_process_stats
tools.description: Get engine performance monitors (FPS, frame time, memory, draw calls, object counts).

tools.name: godot_get_project_info
tools.description: Returns project name, path, Godot version and main scene. Requires Godot editor to be running with the plugin active.

tools.name: godot_get_project_memory
tools.description: Return the project memory summary file (project_summary.md).

tools.name: godot_get_project_settings
tools.description: Returns the most relevant project settings (application, display, physics, rendering). Requires Godot editor to be running with the plugin active.

tools.name: godot_get_protocol_version
tools.description: Returns the JSON-RPC protocol version used between the MCP server and Godot plugin.

tools.name: godot_get_runtime_node_properties
tools.description: Read properties of a node from the running scene.

tools.name: godot_get_runtime_tree
tools.description: Inspect the running scene tree. Requires the game to be running.

tools.name: godot_get_scene_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the current scene: root name, type, total node count, and node type breakdown.

tools.name: godot_get_scene_tree
tools.description: Get the current edited scene tree as a nested node hierarchy.

tools.name: godot_get_script_dependencies
tools.description: Extract res:// script/resource dependencies from preload/load/extends.

tools.name: godot_get_script_parse_errors
tools.description: Statically detect GDScript parse errors and Godot-3 syntax in project scripts.

tools.name: godot_get_script_symbols
tools.description: Extract class_name, extends, functions, signals and variables from a GDScript file.

tools.name: godot_get_selected_nodes
tools.description: Returns detailed information about nodes currently selected in the Godot editor. Requires Godot editor to be running with the plugin active.

tools.name: godot_get_shader_params
tools.description: Read all shader uniform parameters from a ShaderMaterial on a node.

tools.name: godot_get_signal_map
tools.description: Return cached signal map. Builds it if cache is missing.

tools.name: godot_get_theme_info
tools.description: Inspect all overrides in a Theme resource.

tools.name: godot_get_viewport_image
tools.description: Capture the currently edited scene's viewport (2D/3D canvas) as PNG inside the project.

tools.name: godot_health_check
tools.description: Verifies that the MCP server can reach the Godot plugin over local WebSocket.

tools.name: godot_impact_check
tools.description: Estimate impact of a planned change (file rename/move, signal rename) using the dependency graph and signal map.

tools.name: godot_import_gltf
tools.description: Instance an existing .gltf/.glb model scene imported by Godot under the open scene's parent node.

tools.name: godot_infer_autoloads_from_scripts
tools.description: Scan all GDScript files for singleton/autoload usage (e.g. GameManager.method(), AudioManager.play()) and compare against registered autoloads. Returns missing singletons.

tools.name: godot_infer_input_map_from_scripts
tools.description: Scan all GDScript files for Input.is_action_*() calls and compare against registered InputMap actions. Returns missing actions and optionally registers them automatically.

tools.name: godot_inspect_object
tools.description: Inspect a scene node, an assigned subresource, or an existing .tres/.res resource. Returns paginated stored/editor properties and optionally methods/signals, including script-defined members.

tools.name: godot_is_game_running
tools.description: Check whether the Godot project is currently running.

tools.name: godot_list_autoloads_full
tools.description: List all registered autoloads with full status: path, enabled (* prefix), script_exists, loads_ok, class_name. Use to validate autoload integrity.

tools.name: godot_list_export_presets
tools.description: List all export presets configured in export_presets.cfg.

tools.name: godot_list_files
tools.description: Lists files and directories inside a res:// path. Does not require Godot to be running.

tools.name: godot_list_input_recordings
tools.description: List all input recordings in .godot_mcp/recordings/.

tools.name: godot_list_transactions
tools.description: List all transactions in .godot_mcp/tx/ with their status.

tools.name: godot_mouse_click
tools.description: Simulate a mouse click at (x, y) in window coordinates.

tools.name: godot_mouse_drag
tools.description: Simulate a mouse drag from (from_x, from_y) to (to_x, to_y).

tools.name: godot_mouse_move
tools.description: Simulate moving the mouse cursor to (x, y) in window coordinates.

tools.name: godot_open_scene
tools.description: Open a scene in the Godot editor.

tools.name: godot_paint_gridmap_cells
tools.description: Paint or erase up to 512 GridMap cells in one undoable editor action. Use item=-1 to erase; inspect palette first for valid IDs.

tools.name: godot_patch_file
tools.description: Replaces the first occurrence of old_content with new_content in a file. Creates a backup before patching. Requires read-only mode to be disabled.

tools.name: godot_patch_script
tools.description: Patch a GDScript file by replacing exact content. Creates backup before applying.

tools.name: godot_ping
tools.description: Sends a lightweight heartbeat request to the Godot plugin.

tools.name: godot_prepare_release_checklist
tools.description: Generate a release readiness checklist based on project state (main scene set, scripts validated, conventions, etc.) + write it to .godot_mcp/reports/release_checklist.md.

tools.name: godot_press_action
tools.description: Simulate pressing an Input Map action. If duration_ms is provided, releases after the duration.

tools.name: godot_press_key
tools.description: Simulate pressing a keyboard key. If duration_ms is provided, releases after the duration.

tools.name: godot_project_doctor
tools.description: Comprehensive project health diagnostic. Analyzes scripts for errors, broken scenes, orphan resources, circular dependencies, missing input actions, missing autoloads, invalid export presets, and convention violations. Returns {critical, warnings, suggestions, auto_fix_available}.

tools.name: godot_project_path_to_uid
tools.description: Convert a res:// path to its Godot UID.

tools.name: godot_project_summary
tools.description: Generate a structural summary of the project (counts, main scene, largest files).

tools.name: godot_read_file
tools.description: Reads the full content of a file inside the Godot project. Does not require Godot to be running.

tools.name: godot_read_resource
tools.description: Inspect all storage properties of a .tres or .res resource file.

tools.name: godot_read_script
tools.description: Read a GDScript file inside the Godot project.

tools.name: godot_refactor_safely
tools.description: Run impact_check before applying a rename/move/delete. Returns plan + impact; with dry_run=false applies changes after impact analysis.

tools.name: godot_reimport_asset
tools.description: Reimport an existing project image, audio or glTF asset through Godot. Optionally update existing scalar import settings; creates a backup of .import settings first.

tools.name: godot_release_action
tools.description: Simulate releasing an Input Map action.

tools.name: godot_release_key
tools.description: Simulate releasing a keyboard key.

tools.name: godot_reload_autoload
tools.description: Force reload a single autoload by removing and re-adding the entry. Use after editing the autoload's script to pick up changes.

tools.name: godot_remove_autoload
tools.description: Removes an autoload singleton from the project. Persists to project.godot. Requires read-only mode to be disabled.

tools.name: godot_remove_input_action
tools.description: Removes an Input Map action from the project. Persists to project.godot. Requires read-only mode to be disabled.

tools.name: godot_remove_node
tools.description: Remove a node from the current scene. Cannot remove the root node.

tools.name: godot_remove_node_from_group
tools.description: Remove a node from a group in the current scene.

tools.name: godot_remove_state_machine_state
tools.description: Remove a state from an AnimationStateMachine.

tools.name: godot_remove_state_machine_transition
tools.description: Remove a transition from an AnimationStateMachine.

tools.name: godot_rename_node
tools.description: Rename a node in the current scene.

tools.name: godot_reorder_autoloads
tools.description: Reorder autoloads in load order. Pass full ordered list of names. Order matters when autoloads depend on each other.

tools.name: godot_reparent_node
tools.description: Move a node to a different parent within the current scene.

tools.name: godot_replay_behavior_test
tools.description: Run a complete behavior test: load scenario → run project → optionally replay input recording → capture runtime state → run assertions → stop project. Returns full report.

tools.name: godot_replay_input_recording
tools.description: Read a saved recording and replay each event via the corresponding input RPC. speed_factor scales delay_ms (>1 faster, <1 slower).

tools.name: godot_rollback_transaction
tools.description: Restore all files snapshotted by a transaction back to their original content. Marks transaction as rolled_back.

tools.name: godot_run_all_evals
tools.description: Run all eval cases in evals/cases/*.eval.json. Writes each result + a combined markdown report to evals/results/.

tools.name: godot_run_eval_case
tools.description: Execute a single eval case through its MCP tool (or explicit internal mcp_method), validate the response, and save the result.

tools.name: godot_run_input_sequence
tools.description: Execute a sequence of input events (action_press, action_release, key_press, key_release, key_tap, mouse_move, mouse_click, wait).

tools.name: godot_run_project
tools.description: Run the Godot project main scene via the editor.

tools.name: godot_run_scene
tools.description: Run a specific Godot scene via the editor.

tools.name: godot_run_test_scenario
tools.description: Run a sequence of test steps (assert/run_input/wait_for_condition/take_screenshot) and return aggregated results. Does not modify project files.

tools.name: godot_run_validation_loop
tools.description: Run and stop the project as a boot smoke test. This does not inspect runtime errors; use godot_assert_no_errors and godot_get_last_run_report afterward.

tools.name: godot_run_validation_pipeline
tools.description: Full project validation pipeline: load project info, check editor errors, open main scene, run game for N ms, capture runtime state, check for runtime errors, generate regression test optionally. Returns a structured validation report.

tools.name: godot_run_with_score
tools.description: Capture before snapshot → execute an MCP method via internal RPC → capture after snapshot → return both + delta. Useful for measuring impact of a single operation.

tools.name: godot_safe_refactor_symbol
tools.description: Safely rename or move a symbol (class name, signal, script filename) across the entire project. Runs impact check → dry-run → backup → find/replace in .gd/.tscn/.tres → validate → report.

tools.name: godot_safe_refactor_symbol_v2
tools.description: Context-aware symbol refactor. Classifies each occurrence (identifier/type_hint/string/comment/function_name/class_name) and applies replacement only in selected contexts. Default skips strings + comments.

tools.name: godot_save_input_recording
tools.description: Persist an input event sequence to .godot_mcp/recordings/<name>.json. Each event is {type, delay_ms, params}.

tools.name: godot_save_scene
tools.description: Save the currently open scene in the Godot editor.

tools.name: godot_search_files
tools.description: Searches for files whose name contains the given pattern. Does not require Godot to be running.

tools.name: godot_search_memory
tools.description: Search across all memory files for a substring (case-insensitive).

tools.name: godot_set_audio_bus
tools.description: Configure an existing audio bus (volume, mute, solo, send).

tools.name: godot_set_blend_tree_node
tools.description: Add or configure a node in an AnimationNodeBlendTree.

tools.name: godot_set_collision_layers
tools.description: Set collision_layer and collision_mask bitmasks on a physics body or area node.

tools.name: godot_set_convention
tools.description: Append or update a single convention rule in conventions.md.

tools.name: godot_set_node_property
tools.description: Set a property on a node in the current scene.

tools.name: godot_set_resource_property
tools.description: Set a stored scalar, Vector2, Vector3 or Color property on a node's assigned subresource with UndoRedo. Inspect the object first for its type.

tools.name: godot_set_runtime_node_property
tools.description: Temporarily set a property on a node in the running scene. Reverts when the game stops.

tools.name: godot_set_shader_param
tools.description: Set a uniform parameter on a ShaderMaterial attached to a node.

tools.name: godot_set_theme_color
tools.description: Set a color override in a Theme resource.

tools.name: godot_set_theme_constant
tools.description: Set a constant override in a Theme resource.

tools.name: godot_set_theme_font_size
tools.description: Set a font size override in a Theme resource.

tools.name: godot_set_theme_stylebox
tools.description: Set a StyleBoxFlat override in a Theme resource.

tools.name: godot_set_tree_parameter
tools.description: Set a parameter (condition/blend amount) on an AnimationTree.

tools.name: godot_setup_area_trigger_2d
tools.description: Create an Area2D trigger (Area2D + CollisionShape2D + script with body_entered/exited handlers).

tools.name: godot_setup_camera_2d
tools.description: Add a Camera2D to a parent node (typically the player) and mark it as enabled.

tools.name: godot_setup_camera_3d
tools.description: Add a Camera3D to a parent and mark it as current.

tools.name: godot_setup_collision_2d
tools.description: Add a CollisionShape2D node under a parent. Shape resource must be assigned in editor (limitation: JSON-RPC cannot create Resource instances directly).

tools.name: godot_setup_lighting
tools.description: Add DirectionalLight3D + WorldEnvironment for a basic outdoor scene.

tools.name: godot_setup_navigation_region_2d
tools.description: Add a NavigationRegion2D node. NavigationPolygon resource must be assigned + baked in editor.

tools.name: godot_setup_parallax_background
tools.description: Create a ParallaxBackground with N ParallaxLayer children.

tools.name: godot_setup_physics_body
tools.description: Create a physics body (RigidBody2D, RigidBody3D, StaticBody2D, StaticBody3D) with a child CollisionShape and optional mesh/sprite.

tools.name: godot_setup_third_person_controller
tools.description: Generate a third-person CharacterBody3D controller GDScript template (no nodes created).

tools.name: godot_stop_project
tools.description: Stop the currently running Godot project.

tools.name: godot_stress_test_scene
tools.description: Repeatedly call a runtime introspection RPC to measure latency and confirm scene stability. Useful for FPS/lag detection.

tools.name: godot_take_editor_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the Godot editor main viewport and save it as PNG inside the project.

tools.name: godot_take_game_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the running Godot game and save it as PNG inside the project.

tools.name: godot_tap_key
tools.description: Simulate a keyboard key tap (press immediately followed by release).

tools.name: godot_tilemap_clear
tools.description: Clear all tiles from a TileMap layer.

tools.name: godot_tilemap_fill_rect
tools.description: Fill up to 65536 cells on a TileMapLayer or legacy TileMap with a valid TileSet source. Split larger edits into chunks.

tools.name: godot_tilemap_get_cell
tools.description: Read tile data from a specific TileMap cell.

tools.name: godot_tilemap_get_info
tools.description: Get TileMap metadata: layers, tile set sources, used rect.

tools.name: godot_tilemap_get_used_cells
tools.description: Get all cells currently in use in a TileMap layer.

tools.name: godot_tilemap_set_cell
tools.description: Set a tile cell in a TileMapLayer or legacy TileMap with an assigned TileSet source.

tools.name: godot_trace_flow
tools.description: Trace dependency paths from one res:// file to another using the dependency graph.

tools.name: godot_uid_to_project_path
tools.description: Convert a Godot UID (uid://xxxxx) to its res:// path.

tools.name: godot_update_project_memory
tools.description: Update one of the persistent memory files (summary, architecture, conventions, gameplay_systems, current_task).

tools.name: godot_validate_autoloads
tools.description: Verify all registered autoloads have valid script paths and can be loaded. Also checks for singleton usage in scripts.

tools.name: godot_validate_conventions
tools.description: Check naming conventions for scenes, scripts, and assets.

tools.name: godot_validate_input_map
tools.description: Cross-check all scripts for Input.is_action_*() calls and verify every action exists in InputMap with at least one bound key. Returns a pass/fail report.

tools.name: godot_validate_scene
tools.description: Validate that a .tscn file is loadable. Uses the currently open scene if path is omitted.

tools.name: godot_validate_script
tools.description: Validate a GDScript file with Godot and report Godot 3 syntax warnings for Godot 4 targets.

tools.name: godot_validation_compare
tools.description: Compare two validation snapshots and report regressions/improvements per metric.

tools.name: godot_validation_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a project health snapshot (errors, circular deps, unused resources, FPS) and compute score 0-100. Use before/after operations to measure regression.

tools.name: godot_wait_for_condition
tools.description: Poll a node property until it equals the expected value or timeout expires.

tools.name: godot_write_file
tools.description: Writes content to a file inside the Godot project. Creates the file if it does not exist. Requires read-only mode to be disabled. Creates a backup before overwriting.
